text: The assigned removal makes vendored-Rust verification an unguarded export prerequisite and removes the old constant from EWS protocol/test registration and URI construction. The accepted source retains these build and parser roles with later Exchange naming and URL handling. A listed test directory or URI-construction branch does not prove test execution, protocol networking or a successful platform build.
title: Rust constant removal updates its build and URI consumers separately
